name: ronnieops-pi-search-hub
description: Unified web search + content extraction extension for pi — 12 backends (DuckDuckGo, Jina AI, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Serper, Firecrawl, Marginalia, LangSearch, WebSearchAPI, Perplexity Sonar, SearXNG) with auto-fallback, RRF combine mode, web_read tool, and env/shell credential resolution.
